questions.stem: Approximately how many Indians does microfinance serve?
questions.passage_context: Microfinance has revolutionised access to credit for low-income Indian households. Self-help groups (SHGs), microfinance institutions (MFIs), and small finance banks together serve over 100 million borrowers, primarily women. The model — small, unsecured loans repaid in regular instalments — has empowered millions to start businesses, manage household expenses, and weather crises. Yet rapid growth has also raised concerns about over-indebtedness in some regions. Regulatory frameworks have evolved to address consumer protection, interest rate caps, and ethical recovery practices. The next phase will focus on integrating digital channels and expanding to underserved geographies.
questions.subject: ENGLISH
